description: E-B (intra-frame RIS reconfiguration: E-B1 mechanism + VA-5, E-B2 timing) on scenarios/studies/lab_arc.yaml; aggregated results of one AWS run, copied unchanged from the run's results directory

data_class_notes.SIM-sremu: every result value (EVM, BER, PER, VA-5) comes from sremu runs
data_class_notes.ASSUMED: an input, not a result: the two lab cell states have |Gamma| = 1 (the library has no measured magnitudes)

geometry_label: modelled on the lab arrangement (SIM, nominal geometry)
geometry_note: nominal values (middle of the author-supplied intervals: R 1.95 m, span 46 deg, centre 22.5 deg, height 1.0 m); not a measured geometry; no measurement is compared with these runs
assumptions: lab state amplitudes |Gamma| = 1 ASSUMED (alphabet 'lab'); ideal 1-bit {1, -1} also run
six tiles act as one RIS: joint exact optimum over every cell; one command per panel at the same time
LOS blocked: one opaque plate across both LOS segments; occluders act on the LOS only, so the RIS hops are unattenuated (idealized regime 'LOS removed, RIS hops unattenuated') [ENG]
TX power set for Es/N0 = 25 dB at RX1 under its own optimum; Es/N0 = 15 dB is the pre-declared sensitivity of the LOS-present slice (eb_plan.json 'pre_declared')
free space with LOS plus the RIS; isotropic antennas in the horizontal plane [ENG]

host.region: ap-south-1 (inferred from the apt mirror in the job log, not recorded by the manifests)
host.os: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (noble; apt suites in the job log, glibc 2.39)

sremu.commit_source: SREMU_GIT_COMMIT / SREMU_GIT_DIRTY=0 exported by the AWS job script (host/job_stdout.txt, line 1); git_state.json and every manifest record git_commit null because the job's copy (/opt/job/sremu) was not a git work tree; the run's code hashes equal those of the commit (see commit_verified)
sremu.local_src_note: the run's src/sremu tree hash differs from the local checkout (HEAD moved after 5be649a); the experiment drivers and scenarios listed above are byte-identical. The tree of 5be649a itself is checked in commit_verified

commit_verified.method: read-only, no git process: the tree of commit 5be649a was rebuilt from the loose objects in sremu/.git/objects (zlib) and hashed as experiments/common.py:code_hashes() does (sorted src/sremu/**/*.py, path + NUL + bytes); each hashed file and the state library were compared blob by blob
commit_verified.local_smoke: python -m experiments.eb --scenario scenarios/studies/lab_arc.yaml --smoke on the local checkout (Windows, HEAD 309c633 with uncommitted edits): the E-B1 point (lab, LOS present, step, 0.25 T_p) equals the run's row (bit errors, EVM to 7e-15 dB; every per-symbol EVM within 7e-15 dB); the 50 packets of the E-B2 smoke point equal the first 50 packets of the run's point (bit errors and timing identical; EVM to the last digit)
commit_verified.conclusion: the run used the code of commit 5be649a: its src/sremu tree, its 13 hashed drivers and scenarios, and its lab state library; the dirty flag 0 of the job export is consistent with this for every hashed file

not_in_wp11_index: this run is not part of sweeps/results/summary.json (the WP11 index); tools/gen_results.py reads E-B-arc directly
